Name: Goomy Pet Replacement
Author: BlastoGypsy
Description:
I saw a lot of Pokemon replacers for pets and I said "I really want a goomy one!", but couldn't find one, so I made one.
Just drag the cat.xnb and dog.xnb into SteamApps/common/Stardew Valley/Content/Animals, and replace the cat.xnb and dog.xnb that are in there!
Remember to back up any .xnb files your replace, just in case!

I am not claiming to own Goomy or Pokemon in uploading this.

Downloads.Description: Replaces your dog or cat with Goomy
